# Zain Ventures India — Bus Booking Rourkela

> Zain Ventures India is a bus rental and hire service based in Rourkela, Odisha, India. We provide AC and Non-AC buses, tempo travellers, cars, and trucks for weddings, corporate events, pilgrimages, school trips, picnics, and outstation travel. Available 24/7 with professional drivers.

## Services

- AC and Non-AC Bus Hire: 20, 30, 35, 40, and 50-seater buses available
- Tempo Traveller Rental: 12-seater and 17-seater with AC and driver
- Wedding and Event Bus: Decorated luxury buses for marriages, engagements, baraat
- Corporate Transportation: Employee commute, conferences, team outings
- Outstation Bus Hire: Rourkela to Puri, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Sambalpur, Konark, Chilika, Simlipal, and all destinations
- School and College Trip Bus: GPS-tracked buses for excursions, industrial visits, NCC camps
- Pilgrimage Bus: Temple tours and tirth yatra to Puri, Varanasi, Deoghar, Gaya
- Picnic and Holiday Bus: Family outings, birthday parties, festival travel
- Car Rental: Sedans and SUVs for business and leisure travel
- Truck Rental: Cargo trucks for logistics and goods transportation

## Fleet
